purpose: Forensic discrepancy register and remediation mapping for independent review findings of CTO Directive 105.
governance: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.2 / Rule IV-001 (Non-Self-Acceptance)

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Directive 105 report treated Git commit history (be4ba41) and in-repo hashes as independent approval evidence.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Explicit classification: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_ESTABLISHED. In-repository trust anchor status: IN_REPOSITORY_INTEGRITY_ONLY. Proposed external Cosign/GPG root authority manifest classified as PROPOSED_NOT_ACTIVE.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Conflation of repository commit immutability with external governing approval authority.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Origin commit be4ba41 is an immutable comparison baseline for detecting drift in repository state, but repository history alone cannot self-authenticate as an independent approval authority.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Classified governing authority as NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_ESTABLISHED across all 15 governing sources, master specification, traceability matrix, and audit inventory. Defined PROPOSED_NOT_ACTIVE out-of-band cryptographic anchor architecture.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Test labeled as proving coordinated tampering supplied an all-zero expectedHashOverride parameter, testing an invalid hash rather than a coordinated mutation attack.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Replaced with 9 genuine adversarial test cases in Suite 27 exercising the real public verification path with isolated fixtures.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Seam in test harness where an internal override parameter was supplied instead of executing an adversarial multi-file mutation attack.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 105 attempted to prove tampering resilience via caller-supplied option override rather than mutating physical or in-memory fixtures.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Authored Suite 27 (tests/political-intelligence-directive-106.test.mjs) with 9 genuine adversarial cases mutating task identities, weights, stages, document digests, snapshots, criteria, phantom tasks, and manifest logs against the public reconciliation entry point.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Verification functions accepted caller-provided hash and commit overrides in options (e.g. expectedHashOverride, historicalOriginCommitOverride).
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Strict caller trust override prohibition: verifiers reject caller-supplied trust overrides and throw CALLER_TRUST_OVERRIDE_PROHIBITED.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Optional debug/test parameters inadvertently exposed in public verification function signatures.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 105 reconciler allowed options.expectedHashOverride to bypass immutable origin comparisons.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Enforced fail-closed caller-trust override prohibition guards in verifyHistoricalArtifactIntegrity, verifyAuthorityBoundary, verifyGoverningSpecificationProvenance, and reconcileExecutionLedger.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Verifiers used file existence, line counts, or superficial string inclusion checks (e.g., checking for "1207" in SQL text, checking "stateCode === 'TS' ? 2023" absence without testing behavior).
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Substantive domain verifiers implemented: SQL DDL constraint/nullability/relationship checks, GeoJSON bbox/closed-rings/AC 119 defect checks, organization manifest-to-SQL tuple reconciliation, and VM-based behavioral testing across mapped, unmapped, and null inputs.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Superficial string matching in test specifications rather than substantive semantic and behavioral evaluation.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directives 100-105 relied on text-level checks in some criteria verifiers.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Upgraded all 4 verifiers to substantive executable procedures: CRIT-B101-01 validates full DDL, constraints, and 4,123 seat inserts; CRIT-B104-01 validates closed rings, coordinates, bbox, and detects AC 119 defect; CRIT-C02-01 reconciles 107 canonical orgs and 1,043 aliases between JSON and SQL; CRIT-G02-01 executes VM behavioral evaluation for mapped, unmapped, and null inputs.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Criteria evidence register lacked standardized evidence class taxonomy across all 50 criteria.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: All 50 criteria assigned one of 5 standard classes: 32 STATIC_SEMANTIC_VERIFICATION, 5 ARTIFACT_PRESENCE_ONLY, 5 DATABASE_STAGING_VERIFICATION, 5 EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_VERIFICATION, 3 EXECUTABLE_BEHAVIOR_VERIFICATION.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 105 introduced criterion evidence register but did not enforce evidence classification taxonomy.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Updated w021_5_criterion_evidence_register.json, w021_5_criterion_evidence_register.md, TASK_SPECIFICATIONS, and evaluateTaskCriteria with explicit evidenceClass schema validation and reporting.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Manifest recorded test execution without explicit execution qualification distinguishing repository-recorded from CI-reproduced or independently reproduced results.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Explicit execution qualification REPOSITORY_RECORDED_EXECUTION added to manifest and suite records; parsed exit codes and zero-skipped claims validated against captured logs.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Unqualified execution reporting that did not separate committed test logs from independent runtime reproduction.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directives 100-105 test execution runner did not qualify execution provenance context.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Added REPOSITORY_RECORDED_EXECUTION qualification, enhanced parseTestOutput with skipped count extraction, and hardened validateManifestIntegrity to enforce zero-skipped verification against raw process output.
